shared_elements: single large figure occupying most of a rectangular panel
striated/feather-like or plumed texture in parallel rows
narrow horizontal band with repeated small signs along one edge of the panel
low-relief carving on a flat framed field
justification: Both surfaces present a single dominant figure filling a framed rectangular field, bordered by a narrow register of small repeated signs along one edge, and both show areas of parallel striated, feather- or plume-like texture, which is the most specific correspondence available. But B unmistakably depicts a raptor-headed winged being in profile with a hooked beak, curled locks and huge multi-tiered wings and outstretched arm, whereas A's imagery is too generalized to show any comparable creature, posture or attribute, and its manner of rendering is flat and schematic rather than densely modelled and ornamentally detailed.
